name: emotion_context_v1_lite
description: Larger controlled stimulus-response dictionary for ASNE v1-lite. Labels are stimulus categories for predicted response similarity only, not diagnoses or measurements of mental state.

neutral.text: A person walks beside a row of closed shops while a delivery truck turns at the corner.
Someone places a folded jacket on a chair and checks the time before the next appointment.
A person rinses a cup in the sink and sets it beside a stack of clean plates.
Someone reads a posted schedule, writes down a room number, and walks toward the elevator.
A person carries a paper bag through a quiet lobby as rain taps against the windows.

threat.text: A person hears rapid steps close behind them as the stairwell door swings open.
Someone notices a shadow moving across the kitchen floor after a window latch clicks.
A person sees a car roll slowly beside them twice while the street ahead stays empty.
Someone reaches for a phone when a locked gate rattles hard in the alley.
A person steps back as a stranger blocks the hallway and keeps one hand inside a coat.

sadness.text: A person folds an old scarf and leaves it in a box after reading a final note.
Someone sits at a kitchen table after a farewell call and watches the screen go dark.
A person closes the door to an empty bedroom and carries the last bag to the car.
Someone removes a name card from a desk and places it carefully inside a drawer.
A person stands by a train platform long after the departing lights have disappeared.

confusion.text: A person compares two tickets with different gates and turns back toward the information board.
Someone follows arrows down one corridor, then finds the same arrows pointing back the other way.
A person tries to assemble a shelf, but the diagram skips the part already in their hand.
Someone reads a message with missing words and pauses before replying to the group.
A person enters a building number from the note, but the directory lists a different company.

relief.text: A person finds the missing passport inside a side pocket just before leaving for the station.
Someone sees the repair crew arrive after water has been spreading across the hallway floor.
A person receives the overdue confirmation and lowers their shoulders while closing the laptop.
Someone reaches the curb as the driver waves and keeps the car waiting.
A person opens the envelope and sees that the missing payment was recorded on time.
